ai_show_review.summary: High‑energy Greek Theatre set with stellar Playin’ > UJB and tight jams
ai_show_review.blurb: The May 21 1982 show bursts with a searing Bertha → Greatest Story opening, soaring Bird Song leads and a smoking Playin' → Uncle John's jam that drives the second set. Black Peter and Sugar Magnolia close out a night of crisp soundboard recordings and relentless groove.
ai_show_review.review:
What unfolds at the Greek Theatre on May 21‑’82 is a quintessential early‑80s Dead night, packed with high‑octane transitions and inspired solos. The first set kicks off with a blistering Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told that showcases Jerry’s higher‑mobility lead work and Brent’s organ textures, while Bird Song finds the guitarist cruising on bright, lyrical phrasing. Big River erupts into an unplanned jam that lets the rhythm section stretch out before settling back into the groove.

The second set is where the night truly shines: a flawless Playin' > Uncle John's Band segue launches into a thunder‑rich drum/space segment and then rockets through Space → The Wheel with seamless flow. From there, the band rides a tight, exploratory jam that lands on Black Peter—still compelling despite a minor slip—and wraps up with an exuberant Sugar Magnolia. Throughout, Mickey’s percussive antics and Bill’s steady foundation keep the momentum cooking, while Brent’s keyboards add color at every turn. The soundboard captures are crystal‑clear, giving listeners the full spectrum of this electric performance.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard capture with crisp, full‑spectrum audio; minor low‑end distortion only, and widely praised for clarity across the entire set.

key_highlights: Smoking Playin' > Uncle John's Band jam that drives the second set
Tight Bertha → Greatest Story Ever Told opener with soaring leads
Seamless Space → The Wheel transition captured beautifully
Black Peter performance stands out despite a minor slip

band_performance.Jerry: Jerry’s guitar was bright and agile, delivering crisp leads on Bird Song, a soaring solo in the Playin' > Uncle John's jam, and flawless tone throughout.
band_performance.Phil: "PHILNESS!!" – Phil provides a powerful low‑end presence, dueling with Jerry early in the second set and anchoring every jam with solid, resonant bass.
band_performance.Bob: Bob’s rhythm work shines in the pre‑drums jam and his interplay with Brent adds a rich, supportive texture to the improvisations.
band_performance.Brent: Brent’s organ is very active, adding lovely color throughout Playin', driving the jam into drums, and keeping the second‑set flow tight.
band_performance.Mickey: Mickey delivers energetic percussion, tight timing on the first set and a standout drum solo that fuels the space‑to‑wheel transition.
band_performance.Billy: Billy supplies a steady backbone, complementing Mickey’s dynamic flair and keeping the groove locked in.
